name: Skarra Ashkeel
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Blackstrand: a Slagborn raid captain who beaches her longboats on the black sand. P1 'The Landing': a keel-axe cleave, flaming arrows from the boats, a boat-ram charge down a line, and the Ash Horn — a blast the size of the beach; hide behind a stack of harbour crates. P2 at 55% 'Burn the Boats': she stands behind a fire-rite ward while raiders pour off the boats — SET ALL THREE TARRED LONGBOATS ALIGHT (use them) to strand her raiders and break the ward. P3, a new health bar 'No Retreat': a stand-together stack, keel sweeps in four directions and a get-in-close ring. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (three boats to burn under raiders, a stack that needs 3). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and raider adds by players enrolled; stack need = clamp(players/4, 2, 5).

pull: Beach the boats! Everything that burns, burn it!
Port Vharl! Your harbour is ours by sundown.
Skarra Ashkeel steps off the prow with an axe in each hand.
say.death: Skarra Ashkeel drops to her knees in the surf. 'Push... the boats... off...'
say.reset: Skarra Ashkeel whistles her crews back to the boats.

enrage.say: Skarra Ashkeel has run out of patience — the whole beach burns!

soft.say: More raiders wade ashore. The sand is black with them.

fire_arrows.name: Fire Arrows
fire_arrows.say: Archers on the boats — fire arrows!

boat_ram.name: Boat Ram
boat_ram.say: Skarra drives a boat up the sand at {target} — get out of the line!

ash_horn.name: Ash Horn
ash_horn.say: THE ASH HORN! Get behind the crates!

pitch_rain.name: Pitch Rain
pitch_rain.say: Burning pitch rains from the boats — and it keeps burning!

phases.name: Burn the Boats
phases.say: Hold the beach! Nobody touches my boats!

ward.say: Skarra stands behind a fire-rite ward. Burn all three tarred longboats! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

onEnter.say: Skarra stands behind a fire-rite ward. Burn all three tarred longboats! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

do.say: All three longboats go up in flames! Skarra howls as her ward gutters out.
The crates are kindling. Nothing left to hide behind!
